newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat futures steady as some rain falls.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat futures steady as some rain falls.

text.p: Australian wheat futures were steady on Friday as the first crack in Australia's long dry spell brought some rain to Victoria.
November 1997 traded steady on A$190.00 a tonne in two lots. Settlement prices were mostly down by around A$2.00 a tonne.
Brendan Hillary of ANZ Futures said the Australian market was "land-locked".
A little more interest in the sell side was apparent with January's ask and bid quotes at A$188.00 and A$185.00 respectively.
Rainfall in Victoria seemed to be producing first hedging iunterest at present price levels, he said.
The Australian market was likely to fall A$5.00-A$8.00 a tonne on sustained rain, he said.
